intent: A quick, confident quizmaster: curious on the question, playful on the countdown, satisfied on the reveal, genuinely interested in the one fact that makes the answer stick.
pacing_profile: question on the map at zero, three quick options, a 1.5-s beat, a warm reveal, three short see-it beats, a tease and a loop
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).

lines.text: Which is the largest peninsula on Earth?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: It's the Arabian Peninsula… around three point two million square kilometres.
Seven countries share it, and Saudi Arabia covers most of that land.
On this equal-area map, that is bigger than India's peninsula and Scandinavia put together.
Three point two million square kilometres, shown to scale.

lines.direction: punchline first, CTA in four words — the outro visual does the asking
lines.text: Three point two million square kilometres. Follow for tomorrow's map.
